comments.author: @skipandcherieadventures116
comments.text: I am greatly saddened as I look at Guam today.   Our family lived and worked there 1980-1986.  We were privileged to have the Pope visit and conduct mass in what was Agana, we had the President and First Lady visit…..I was fortunate to meet them when Air Force arrived at the airport.  Lastly we had a Miss World crowned while we lived there.  We have experienced several typhoons while there.  Attending village fiesta was something we did as I was a teacher in a couple of villages and were invited.  We have experienced the island from one end to the other end and even inland .  We have enjoyed dinner at the Government House……we loved our 6 years living both in Talofofo and Windward Hills.  I took flying lessons there and enjoyed landing amid military planes.  Your video did saddened us as you do not pronounce many of the words correctly……we loved our time there❤️❤️❤️I do have two degrees from UOG too!  When I was teaching, one of my student teachers was the daughter of the Superintendent…….yes we know a lot about Guam and have great memories! Furthermore, they drive on the right side of the road not the way some of what you showed!
